source.name: TaxParcelPublic / Oklahoma County Tax Parcels

source.scope: Oklahoma County parcel layer; verified sample covers the Oklahoma County portion of Oklahoma City only, not every county within the city limits
source.crs: Layer WKID 102724 (latest WKID 2267); sample returned in EPSG:4326
source.idFieldSemantics: The public popup labels accountno as Account Number. It is an assessment-account grouping key, not a row-unique feature ID: countywide aggregate queries found repeated accountno values. Use complete components and verify same-account pin/propertyid consistency; OBJECTID/globalid are transport or row IDs, not parcel identity.
source.reuseStatus: Public ArcGIS item states no special restrictions or limitations were provided; no explicit reuse licence was found. County layer used for the accepted sample.

liveAcceptance.geometryPolicy: Account components were read in full, grouped by accountno, checked for matching pin/propertyid, and rejected on positive-area overlap or inconsistent groups.

aggregateIdentityCheck.method: ArcGIS server-side count and distinct-value aggregate queries; no parcel geometries or owner attributes returned
aggregateIdentityCheck.note: Both identifier columns have 632 nulls and repeated non-null values countywide. They are not one-row-unique; accountno is used as the assessment-account identity and repeated rows are handled as validated components.

freshness.note: The layer's editingInfo dataLastEditDate is the data timestamp. The ArcGIS item's modified field is item-metadata time and is older. ArcGIS's indexed item page reports a separate July 25, 2026 data date; the live layer metadata now reports September 26, 2026.

remainingUncertainty: The accepted layer verifies the Oklahoma County portion of Oklahoma City, not all municipal parcels in Oklahoma City. The source includes repeated and null accountno/pin values countywide, so complete account components must continue to be grouped and validated. The OGI statewide WFS query returned polygons but its clearinghouse metadata still documents view-only WMS access and no download; it is a dated alternate candidate, not an accepted adapter source.
nextStep: Use the accepted Oklahoma County ArcGIS source for this capital with accountno complete-parts identity, pin/propertyid consistency checks, and overlap rejection. Keep the OGI 2026 statewide WFS candidate for later source-level comparison and verify city coverage outside Oklahoma County separately.
